content:
The new Apple TV 4K has been long-awaited, originally expected to launch last fall. However, with Siri AI finally ready, all signs point to the new Apple TV 4K making its debut—quite possibly at the September 9 event. Here are the rumours circulating at the moment.

#1: Siri Remote Update

While no details have been disclosed yet, reports suggest Apple will release an updated Siri Remote alongside the new Apple TV 4K.

Code leaked from a version of macOS 26.7 appears to confirm the existence of a new Siri Remote. And prior to this leak, Mark Gurman had also reported that the new hardware could come with an "improved Apple TV remote".

It doesn't look like there will be major changes, but hopefully at least a second-generation ultra-wideband chip will be included to support the "Precision Finding" feature.

#2: Siri AI and More Apple Intelligence Features

Siri AI is expected to be the key selling point of the new Apple TV and other new Home products.

So far, Apple has yet to announce whether the new assistant will land on the Apple TV 4K or HomePod. However, mounting evidence suggests tvOS 27 will include Siri AI, and most likely only support new hardware.

The new Apple TV is also likely to feature other Apple Intelligence capabilities, such as a more powerful search experience.

#3: New A-Series Chip

The current Apple TV uses the A15 Bionic chip that first appeared in 2021. The good news is that the new model is expected to see a significant performance boost.

The new A-series chip will be more powerful and support various AI features.

Rumours suggest the new chip could be the A17 Pro or A18. However, most of these reports surfaced before Siri AI's debut. It wouldn't be surprising if Apple equipped the new hardware with an even more powerful A19 or A20.

#4: N1 Wireless Chip

The N1 wireless chip, which debuted on the iPhone 17, is also reportedly set to feature in the new Apple TV 4K.

With the addition of N1, the Apple TV will support Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, as well as the Thread networking protocol.

By comparison, the current four-year-old Apple TV hardware only supports Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.

What features are you hoping to see in the new Apple TV 4K? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
